
'''Yuga Daigongen''' (瑜伽大権現, 由加大権現)

* {{ill|Yuga Daigongen|ja|瑜伽大権現}} – A deity in {{ill|Shinbutsu-shūgō|en|Shinbutsu-shūgō|qid=Q2279088|lt=Shinbutsu-shūgō}} (the syncretism of Shinto and Buddhism), with {{ill|Amitābha|en|Amitābha|qid=Q236242|lt=Amida Nyorai}} (Amitābha) and {{ill|Bhaisajyaguru|en|Bhaisajyaguru|qid=Q854773|lt=Yakushi Nyorai Medicine Buddha}} (Bhaiṣajyaguru) as its {{ill|Honji suijaku|fi|Honji suijaku|fr|Honji suijaku|id|Honji suijaku|it|Honji suijaku|ja|本地垂迹|ko|본지수적|pt|Honji suijaku|zh|本地垂迹说|qid=Q3080781|lt=Honji Buddha}} (original Buddhist counterparts).
